Delivered: 5 GHz channel operation (#2026 prepare-layer admission; #2089 interface allow_channel + cold bring-up default channel 36 on dual-dual MAC0), HT40, DIG / dynamic TX power / EDCA turbo watchdog steps, software-LPS decisions (enter-core gate, beacon TIM decision, sleep interval), RX RSSI from the PHY status (rx_pwdb_all) — all #2095. RTL8723AE: native firmware startup now composes ePHY, warm-aware LLT/MAC, firmware download, AE PHY/BB/RF/AGC/PG tables and UMC/default setup with terminal failure/cancellation. Channel/BW/LCK and separate IQK/EFUSE/RF6052 preparation ports are implemented. Existing packet/C2H/coexistence owners remain. Open: measured PA-bias and factory-bound calibrated radio handoff, factory-capped current signed grants, coexistence tail and shared ring/H2C/IRQ/station composition. No station admission yet.

RTL8723BE (0xb723): signed legacy/HT20/40 station, coexistence scan/connect/special-packet/IPS, firmware RA, DM false alarms/RSSI/DIG/EDCCA/CCK-PD, short-preamble TX and TX-report matching are implemented. Linked ATC now consumes BSSID-bound native RX CFO samples with source filtering/hysteresis/clamps. EDCA turbo now uses native unicast counters and bounded peer recognition, including Cisco N-mode settings and source watchdog ordering. Open: calibrated TX-power tracking, handshake-EAPOL coexistence before synchronous TX, and PCIe ASPM (#1849). Physical acceptance pending.
